reason: Validation & error matrix for upstream sync: reject patch if web-only files missing, version metadata inconsistent, route coverage regresses, or web-server cargo check fails; also lists the required test commands per change type.
Per-batch risk notes and the web mirroring contract (5 S3 routes + web-commands.ts + msw; OpenCode arm hand-mirrored into web_api/handlers/usage.rs; proxy_web.rs stub parity) that checks must verify.
Acceptance criteria checklist (full gate suite incl. smoke + integration) and explicit out-of-scope/exclusion list the reviewer must enforce.
